blocks.text: Upgrade your outdoor (or indoor) lounging setup with the Arden Deep Seat Pillow Back Cushion—where comfort meets durability in a clean, elevated design. Sized at 23" x 17" x 5", this generously filled back cushion delivers structured support with a soft, sink-in feel that makes long afternoons feel effortless.

Crafted with rain-proof, fade-resistant fabric, it’s designed to hold its color and shape through sun, spills, and everyday use. Whether you're refreshing your patio furniture or adding an extra layer of comfort to your favorite chair, this cushion brings a polished, put-together look without sacrificing performance.
It’s the easiest way to make your space feel more styled—and a lot more comfortable.

items.label: Perfect Deep Seat Fit
items.value: Designed to fit most standard deep seat, sofa, or couch patio furniture, this 23" x 17" x 5" back cushion offers a tailored, supportive feel without slouching or shifting

items.label: Plush Yet Supportive Comfort
items.value: Filled with high-quality cushioning that strikes the ideal balance between softness and structure—so you can lean back and stay comfortable longer

items.label: Weather-Resistant Performance
items.value: Made with durable outdoor fabric that resists fading, moisture, and everyday wear, keeping your space looking fresh season after season

items.label: Versatile Indoor/Outdoor Use
items.value: Equally at home on your patio, porch, or living room seating—perfect for updating furniture without a full replacement

items.label: Easy Style Upgrade
items.value: Instantly refresh your furniture with a clean, modern silhouette that complements a wide range of décor styles, from classic to contemporary

items.label: Low-Maintenance Care
items.value: Spot clean with ease to keep your cushion looking crisp and ready for everyday use
